grammar.key: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.title: 动名词作主语：从基础到拓展（含不定式对比与书面语规范）
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as Subject: Core Usage and Extended Patterns
grammar.usage: 动名词作主语是英语中把“动作”当作“事情”来表达的核心手段。动名词由动词原形加 -ing 构成，在句中具有名词功能，可以单独作主语，也可以带宾语、状语等构成动名词短语作主语。核心结构为“动名词（短语）+ 单数谓语动词”，因为动名词表示一个整体概念，谓语动词通常用单数形式，例如：Learning to knit is relaxing. 否定形式在动名词前加 not，例如：Not exercising regularly can harm your health. 疑问形式可借助 it 作形式主语，例如：Is it worth spending so much time on this? 在高中阶段，动名词作主语常与不定式作主语形成对比：动名词多表示一般性、习惯性、已知的或正在发生的动作；不定式多表示具体的、将来的或一次性的动作。例如：Swimming is good exercise.（泛指游泳这项活动）与 To swim in this river is dangerous.（指在特定情况下游一次泳）。此外，高中书面语中常见“It is no use / no good / useless / worthwhile + doing”等固定句型，以及动名词作主语时用于谚语、标题和正式文体中的现象。初中阶段主要掌握动名词作主语时谓语用单数、常见动名词短语作主语的句子；高中阶段则需要进一步掌握动名词与不定式的语义差异、动名词复合结构作主语、形式主语 it 的用法以及动名词在书面语中的正式表达功能。易错点包括：把动名词与现在进行时混淆；动名词短语作主语时谓语误用复数；在固定句型中误用不定式；以及忽视动名词与不定式在语体和使用场合上的差异。
forms: Gerund + 单数谓语动词：Reading widely helps you think clearly.
Gerund Phrase + 单数谓语动词：Learning to knit from simple designs is encouraging.
Not + Gerund + 单数谓语动词：Not getting enough sleep affects your memory.
It + be + 形容词/名词 + Gerund：It is no use complaining about the past.
It + be + worth + Gerund：It is worth visiting the museum once.
Gerund 复合结构（物主代词/名词所有格 + Gerund）+ 单数谓语动词：His arriving late caused some trouble.
notes: 动名词作主语时，谓语动词必须用单数，即使动名词短语中包含复数名词也不能改变谓语形式。
不要将动名词作主语与现在进行时混淆：动名词作主语时，-ing 形式位于句首且后面紧跟谓语动词，而不是 be 动词。
在 It is no use / no good / useless / worthwhile 等固定句型中，后面通常接动名词，不用不定式，这是高考书面语中的高频考点。
动名词作主语多用于泛指或一般性陈述，不定式作主语多用于具体、将来或一次性动作；在正式书面语中，动名词作主语往往比不定式更常见、更自然。
动名词复合结构作主语时，逻辑主语常用物主代词或名词所有格，如 His coming surprised us，在口语中也可用宾格，但书面语中应优先使用物主代词。

grammar.key: Present Simple Tense for Habits / 一般现在时表示习惯
grammar.title: 一般现在时表示习惯、事实与状态（含频率副词与一般现在时的语域拓展）
grammar.titleEn: Present Simple Tense for Habits, Facts and States (with Frequency Adverbs and Register Extensions)
grammar.usage:
一般现在时用于描述经常性、习惯性的动作或行为，常与 always, usually, often, sometimes, seldom, never, every day/week/month/year, once a week, twice a month 等频率副词或时间状语连用。核心结构为：主语 + 动词原形（主语为第三人称单数时动词加 -s/-es）。肯定句如：She reads novels before bed. 否定句需借助助动词 do/does + not，例如：He doesn't like horror stories. 疑问句将 do/does 提前：Do you often go to the library? / Does she enjoy poetry? 一般现在时也用于表达客观事实、真理、自然现象、时刻表安排以及主语长期存在的状态或爱好。

与现在进行时对比：现在进行时强调说话时正在发生或现阶段暂时进行的动作，而一般现在时强调长期、稳定、反复发生的动作或状态。例如：I read novels every night.（习惯）与 I am reading a novel now.（正在进行的动作）。与一般过去时对比：一般过去时表示过去某时间发生的动作或存在的状态，而现在一般时表示现在或长期存在的状态。例如：He loved comics when he was a child.（过去）与 He loves novels now.（现在）。

初中阶段主要要求掌握一般现在时的基本结构、第三人称单数变化规则以及常见频率副词的位置。高中阶段则进一步要求：在书面语中准确使用一般现在时表达观点、评论、书评或影评；在时间状语从句和条件状语从句中用一般现在时代替一般将来时；在新闻报道标题或小说叙述中理解“历史现在时”的用法；并能区分一般现在时与现在完成时在表达“持续状态”时的差异。

易错点：1. 第三人称单数动词变化不规则，如 go→goes, do→does, have→has, study→studies, watch→watches。2. 否定句和疑问句中用了 does 后，动词要还原为原形，不能再用第三人称单数形式。3. 频率副词通常位于实义动词之前、be 动词或助动词之后。4. 在 if / when / as soon as / unless 等引导的时间和条件状语从句中，用一般现在时表将来，主句用一般将来时。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + 动词原形/动词第三人称单数形式（+ 其他）
否定句：主语 + do/does + not + 动词原形（+ 其他）
一般疑问句：Do/Does + 主语 + 动词原形（+ 其他）？
特殊疑问句：疑问词 + do/does + 主语 + 动词原形（+ 其他）？
频率副词位置：主语 + 频率副词 + 实义动词 / 主语 + be + 频率副词
时间/条件状语从句：If/When/Unless + 主语 + 一般现在时, 主语 + will + 动词原形
notes: 高考书面语中，一般现在时常用于议论文、书评、影评中表达观点或评价，如：The novel explores the complexity of human nature.
在 if / when / as soon as / unless 等引导的时间和条件状语从句中，必须用一般现在时代替一般将来时，这是高考语法填空和短文改错的高频考点。
第三人称单数动词变化规则中，以辅音字母加 y 结尾的动词要变 y 为 i 再加 -es，如 study→studies, carry→carries；以 s, x, ch, sh, o 结尾的动词加 -es，如 go→goes, watch→watches。
否定句和疑问句中，助动词 does 已经体现了第三人称单数，后面的实义动词必须用原形，不能写成 He doesn't likes... 或 Does she goes...。
一般现在时与现在完成时在表达“持续状态”时不同：一般现在时强调现在仍然存在的状态，而现在完成时强调从过去持续到现在的动作或状态，常与 for / since 连用。

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense / 现在完成时
grammar.title: 现在完成时：从“过去动作”到“现在影响”的桥梁（含与一般过去时、since/for 辨析）
grammar.titleEn: Present Perfect Tense: Linking Past Actions to Present Results
grammar.usage:
现在完成时的核心结构是“have/has + 过去分词”。它不单纯描述过去发生了什么，而是站在“现在”的角度回看过去，强调过去动作与现在的联系。主要用法有两大类：一是表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果，常译为“已经……了”；二是表示从过去某一时间开始一直持续到现在的动作或状态，常与 since、for 连用。
肯定句结构为“主语 + have/has + 过去分词”，否定句在 have/has 后加 not，疑问句将 have/has 提到主语之前。例如：I have met some wonderful people. / She hasn't finished yet. / Have you ever tried this? 注意 have/has 的选择取决于主语人称和数，与过去分词本身无关。
与一般过去时的对比是高中阶段的核心难点。一般过去时强调动作发生在过去某个具体时间，常与 yesterday、last week、in 2019、two days ago 等明确的过去时间状语连用；而现在完成时不与这类具体过去时间连用，因为它关注的是“现在的结果或经验”，而非“过去的时间点”。例如：I lost my key yesterday.（强调昨天丢的）与 I have lost my key.（强调现在钥匙不见了，进不了门）。
初中阶段主要掌握现在完成时的基本构成和 already、yet、ever、never、just 等常见标志词；高中阶段则要进一步理解“未指明时间的过去经验”“与 since/for 连用的持续性”“have been to / have gone to / have been in 的区别”以及现在完成时与现在完成进行时的语感差异。高中书面表达中，现在完成时常用于开头段引出背景或总结影响，如“In recent years, great changes have taken place in our school.”
易错点一：把现在完成时与具体过去时间连用，如“I have met him yesterday”是错误的，应改为“I met him yesterday”或“I have met him before”。易错点二：混淆 have been to（去过某地，已回来）和 have gone to（去了某地，还没回来）。易错点三：since 后接时间点，for 后接时间段，二者不可混用，如“since two years”错误，应为“for two years”或“since two years ago”。易错点四：短暂性动词（如 come、go、leave、buy、die）在肯定句中通常不能与 for/since 表示持续，需转换为延续性表达，如“He has bought the book for a week”应改为“He has had the book for a week”。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + have/has + 过去分词
否定句：主语 + have/has + not + 过去分词
一般疑问句：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词?
与 since 连用：现在完成时 + since + 过去时间点/一般过去时从句
与 for 连用：现在完成时 + for + 时间段
have been to + 地点（去过已回） / have gone to + 地点（去了未回） / have been in + 地点（待在某地一段时间）
notes: 高考书面表达中，现在完成时常与 in recent years、over the past few years、so far、up to now 等时间状语搭配，用于描述变化或成就，注意主谓一致。
在正式书面语中，already 通常用于肯定句，yet 用于否定句和疑问句；口语中 already 也可用于疑问句表示惊讶，但高考写作建议遵循正式语域规则。
since 引导时间状语从句时，从句常用一般过去时，主句用现在完成时，例如：Great changes have taken place since the new policy was introduced.
短暂性动词在肯定句中不能与 for/since 直接连用，需转换为延续性动词或状态表达，这是高考语法填空和短文改错的高频考点。
注意不规则动词的过去分词拼写，如 written、broken、chosen、hidden、ridden 等，高考语法填空常直接考查过去分词形式。

examples.en: I have already finished my homework.
examples.cn: 我已经完成作业了。

examples.en: She has never been to Beijing.
examples.cn: 她从未去过北京。

examples.en: We have lived in this city since 2015.
examples.cn: 自2015年以来，我们一直住在这座城市。

examples.en: He has gone to the library, so he can't answer the phone right now.
examples.cn: 他去了图书馆，所以现在不能接电话。

examples.en: Over the past decade, significant progress has been made in environmental protection.
examples.cn: 在过去十年里，环境保护方面取得了重大进展。

examples.en: Having lived abroad for several years, she has developed a deep understanding of cross-cultural communication.
examples.cn: 由于在国外生活了几年，她对跨文化交流有了深刻的理解。

exercises.q: I ______ my homework, so I can play outside now.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时表示过去动作对现在造成影响，所以用 have finished。

exercises.q: She ______ never ______ to Beijing.
exercises.explain: have/has been to 表示去过某地，主语 she 用 has。

exercises.q: ______ you ______ your new classmate yet?
exercises.explain: yet 常用于现在完成时疑问句，表示已经做了某事。

exercises.q: My brother ______ his key. He can't open the door.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时强调过去丢钥匙对现在的影响——开不了门。

exercises.q: They ______ in this city since 2018.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语时，主句常用现在完成时。

exercises.q: We ______ (already / see) that movie.
exercises.explain: already 用于现在完成时，放在 have/has 和过去分词之间。

exercises.q: He ______ (not finish) his lunch yet.
exercises.explain: yet 用于否定句，现在完成时结构为 has not + 过去分词。

exercises.q: I ______ (meet) many nice people at the club.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时表示过去遇到的人对现在仍有影响或联系。

exercises.q: The sentence "She has went to the library." is correct.
exercises.explain: go 的过去分词是 gone，不是 went。

exercises.q: The sentence "I have known him for three years." is correct.
exercises.explain: for + 时间段与现在完成时连用，表示持续到现在的状态。

exercises.q: I have done my homework. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: I have not done my homework.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定句在 have/has 后加 not。

exercises.q: She has visited the museum. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 现在完成时疑问句将 has 提到主语前。

exercises.q: He can swim. (用 be able to 改写)
exercises.explain: can 表示能力时可与 be able to 互换，注意人称和时态。

exercises.q: I have finish my breakfast.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时中 have 后要用过去分词 finished。

exercises.q: They has bought a new car.
exercises.answer: They have bought a new car.
exercises.explain: 主语 they 是复数，助动词要用 have。

exercises.q: —Where is Tom? —He ______ to the library. He'll be back in an hour.
exercises.explain: has gone to 表示去了某地还没回来，符合语境。

exercises.q: I ______ this book twice. It's really interesting.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时表示过去的经历，twice 强调次数。

exercises.q: She ______ her leg, so she can't walk now.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时强调过去受伤对现在的影响——不能走路。

exercises.q: We ______ each other since primary school.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语，主句用现在完成时表示持续到现在的状态。

exercises.q: ______ you ever ______ to a concert?
exercises.explain: ever 常用于现在完成时疑问句，have been to 表示去过某地。

exercises.q: The train ______ (just / arrive). Let's hurry.
exercises.explain: just 用于现在完成时，表示刚刚发生的动作。

exercises.q: I ______ (not see) him for a long time.
exercises.explain: for a long time 与现在完成时连用，表示从过去持续到现在。

exercises.q: How long ______ you ______ (study) English?
exercises.explain: How long 询问持续时间，常用现在完成时。

exercises.q: The sentence "He has been to Shanghai last year." is correct.
exercises.explain: 有具体过去时间 last year 时不能用现在完成时，要用一般过去时。

exercises.q: The sentence "I have lost my phone. I can't find it anywhere." is correct.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时表示过去丢手机对现在的影响——找不到。

exercises.q: They have already cleaned the classroom. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: They have not cleaned the classroom yet.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定句中 already 要改为 yet。

exercises.q: I have been to the Great Wall. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Have you been to the Great Wall?
exercises.explain: 现在完成时疑问句将 have 提前，人称做相应变化。

exercises.q: She could read when she was four. (用 be able to 改写)
exercises.answer: She was able to read when she was four.
exercises.explain: could 表示过去能力时可与 was/were able to 互换。

exercises.q: I have bought this bike since two years ago.
exercises.answer: I have had this bike since two years ago.
exercises.explain: buy 是短暂性动词，不能与 since 连用，要改为延续性动词 have。

exercises.q: She has wrote three emails today.
exercises.answer: She has written three emails today.
exercises.explain: write 的过去分词是 written，不是 wrote。

exercises.q: By the time he arrived, we ______ already ______ the meeting.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间状语从句时，主句用过去完成时。

exercises.q: It is the first time that I ______ such a beautiful sunset.
exercises.explain: It is the first time that 从句中常用现在完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ in this company since she graduated from university.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时表示持续到现在的动作。

exercises.q: —You look tired. —Yes, I ______ non-stop all morning.
exercises.explain: 现在完成进行时强调动作从过去持续到现在且可能继续，符合语境。

exercises.q: He ______ his passport, so he can't travel abroad next week.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时强调过去丢护照对现在的影响——下周不能出国。

exercises.q: By the end of last month, they ______ (complete) the project.
exercises.explain: by the end of last month 是过去时间点，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: I ______ (wait) for you for over an hour. Where have you been?
exercises.explain: 现在完成进行时强调动作持续到现在且可能继续，带有情绪色彩。

exercises.q: This is the most interesting book I ______ ever ______ (read).
exercises.explain: 最高级与 ever 连用时常用现在完成时表示经历。

exercises.q: The sentence "He has left for two days." is correct.
exercises.explain: leave 是短暂性动词，不能与时间段 for two days 连用。

exercises.q: The sentence "I have been knowing him for ten years." is correct.
exercises.explain: know 是状态动词，通常不用进行时，应说 have known。

exercises.q: He has never been to Japan. (改为反意疑问句)
exercises.answer: He has never been to Japan, has he?
exercises.explain: 反意疑问句遵循前否后肯原则，助动词用 has。

exercises.q: I started learning English five years ago. (用 for 改写为现在完成时)
exercises.answer: I have learned English for five years.
exercises.explain: 将过去时间点转换为时间段，用现在完成时表示持续到现在的动作。

exercises.q: She may be at home now. (用 might 改写，表示更不确定)
exercises.answer: She might be at home now.
exercises.explain: might 比 may 语气更不确定，表示可能性更小。

exercises.q: Having finished his homework, the TV was turned on by him.
exercises.answer: Having finished his homework, he turned on the TV.
exercises.explain: 现在分词短语的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致，这里主句主语应是 he。

exercises.q: She has been married with John for five years.
exercises.answer: She has been married to John for five years.
exercises.explain: be married to 是固定搭配，介词用 to 不用 with。

exercises.q: I ______ my homework, so I can go out to play now.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时强调过去动作对现在造成的影响，作业已完成所以现在能出去玩。

exercises.q: She has ______ to Beijing twice.
exercises.explain: have been to 表示去过某地已回来，have gone to 表示去了还没回来。

exercises.q: — Have you ______ seen a panda? — No, never.
exercises.explain: ever 用于现在完成时疑问句中表示“曾经”。

exercises.q: My brother ______ a new bike. He is very happy.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时表示过去得到新自行车对现在的影响——他现在很高兴。

exercises.q: They ______ in this city since 2018.
exercises.explain: since 2018 表示从过去持续到现在的动作，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: We have ______ (know) each other for five years.
exercises.explain: know 的过去分词是 known，for five years 表示持续到现在。

exercises.q: He has ______ (eat) all the cake.
exercises.explain: eat 的过去分词是 eaten，现在完成时表示蛋糕已被吃完。

exercises.q: I haven't ______ (see) that film yet.
exercises.explain: see 的过去分词是 seen，yet 用于否定句表示“还没”。

exercises.q: The sentence "I have lost my key" means I don't have the key now.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时表示过去丢钥匙的动作对现在的影响——现在没有钥匙。

exercises.q: In the sentence "She has gone to Shanghai", she is still in Shanghai now.
exercises.explain: have gone to 表示去了某地还没回来，人现在还在上海。

exercises.q: I have already cleaned my room. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: I haven't cleaned my room yet.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定句在 have/has 后加 not，already 改为 yet。

exercises.q: He has finished his work. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 现在完成时一般疑问句将 have/has 提到主语前。

exercises.q: They have been to the Great Wall. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: They haven't been to the Great Wall.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定句在 have 后加 not，缩写为 haven't。

exercises.q: I have went to the library.
exercises.answer: I have gone to the library.
exercises.explain: go 的过去分词是 gone，不是 went。

exercises.q: She have already done her homework.
exercises.answer: She has already done her homework.
exercises.explain: 主语是第三人称单数 she，助动词用 has 而不是 have。

exercises.q: By the time we arrived at the cinema, the film ______ for ten minutes.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间，主句动作发生在过去的过去，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: I ______ my English teacher for six years. She teaches very well.
exercises.explain: for six years 表示从过去持续到现在的状态，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: — Where is Tom? — He ______ to the library. He'll be back in an hour.
exercises.explain: have gone to 表示去了还没回来，符合“一小时后回来”的语境。

exercises.q: This is the first time that I ______ such a beautiful sunset.
exercises.explain: This is the first time that 后用现在完成时，表示到目前为止的经历。

exercises.q: She ______ several books about Chinese history so far.
exercises.explain: so far 表示“到目前为止”，常与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: The students ______ (not finish) their project yet.
exercises.explain: yet 用于否定句，主语是复数用 haven't，finish 的过去分词是 finished。

exercises.q: How long ______ you ______ (study) English?
exercises.explain: How long 询问持续时间，用现在完成时 have studied。

exercises.q: My parents ______ (be) married for twenty years.
exercises.explain: be married 表示已婚状态，for twenty years 用现在完成时 have been。

exercises.q: The sentence "He has been in the army for three years" means he joined the army three years ago and is still in the army.
exercises.explain: have been in 表示持续的状态，三年前参军且现在仍在军队。

exercises.q: In the sentence "I have bought this book for two weeks", the verb "bought" is used correctly.
exercises.explain: buy 是短暂性动词，不能与 for two weeks 连用，应改为 have had。

exercises.q: He came to this school three years ago. (用 since 改写为现在完成时)
exercises.answer: He has been at this school since three years ago.
exercises.explain: since three years ago 表示从三年前持续到现在，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: I have never read such an interesting novel. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Have you ever read such an interesting novel?
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 have 提前，never 改为 ever。

exercises.q: She has already finished her homework. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: She hasn't finished her homework yet.
exercises.explain: 否定句在 has 后加 not，already 改为 yet。

exercises.q: I have bought this dictionary for three years.
exercises.answer: I have had this dictionary for three years.
exercises.explain: buy 是短暂性动词，不能与 for 时间段连用，应改为延续性动词 have。

exercises.q: He has left his hometown for ten years.
exercises.answer: He has been away from his hometown for ten years.
exercises.explain: leave 是短暂性动词，不能与 for 时间段连用，应改为 be away from。

exercises.q: By the time he realized his mistake, he ______ the opportunity to correct it.
exercises.explain: realized 是过去时，失去机会发生在意识到之前，用过去完成时表示过去的过去。

exercises.q: It is the third time that the government ______ this policy.
exercises.explain: It is the third time that 后用现在完成时，表示到目前为止已发生三次。

exercises.q: The scientist, who ______ on this project since 2015, will publish his findings next month.
exercises.explain: since 2015 表示从过去持续到现在的动作，用现在完成进行时强调持续不断。

exercises.q: Not until he arrived home ______ that he had left his keys in the office.
exercises.explain: Not until 置于句首，主句用部分倒装，且 realize 发生在 arrived 之后，用一般过去时。

exercises.q: Hardly ______ the station when the train left.
exercises.explain: Hardly...when 句型中，hardly 置于句首用部分倒装，且主句用过去完成时。

exercises.q: By the end of last year, they ______ (complete) the construction of the bridge.
exercises.explain: by the end of last year 表示到过去某时间为止，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ (write) three novels since she became a professional writer.
exercises.explain: since 引导过去时间点，主句用现在完成时表示从过去到现在的成果。

exercises.q: The patient ______ (be) in hospital for two weeks before the doctor decided to operate.
exercises.explain: 住院发生在医生决定手术之前，用过去完成时表示过去的过去。

exercises.q: The sentence "He has been writing the report all morning" emphasizes the ongoing nature of the action rather than its completion.
exercises.explain: 现在完成进行时强调动作从过去持续到现在且可能仍在进行，不强调完成。

exercises.q: In the sentence "She has married for ten years", the verb form is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: marry 是短暂性动词，不能与 for 时间段连用，应改为 has been married。

exercises.q: He last visited his grandparents two years ago. (用 since 改写)
exercises.answer: He hasn't visited his grandparents since two years ago.
exercises.explain: last visited 表示最后一次拜访，用 since 改写为现在完成时否定句。

exercises.q: The company has produced over one million cars since it was founded. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: Over one million cars have been produced by the company since it was founded.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时被动语态结构为 have/has been + 过去分词。

exercises.q: I have never met a more talented musician than her. (用最高级改写)
exercises.answer: She is the most talented musician I have ever met.
exercises.explain: never...more than 结构可转换为最高级表达，用现在完成时强调经历。

exercises.q: Having finished his homework, the TV was turned on by him.
exercises.answer: Having finished his homework, he turned on the TV.
exercises.explain: 现在分词短语的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致，主句主语应为 he 而不是 the TV。

exercises.q: The professor, along with his students, have been working on the experiment for months.
exercises.answer: The professor, along with his students, has been working on the experiment for months.
exercises.explain: along with 连接主语时谓语与前面的主语一致，the professor 是单数，用 has。

grammar.key: Gerund as Object / 动名词作宾语
grammar.title: 动名词作宾语：从 love doing 到只能接 -ing 的高考动词体系
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as Object: From “love doing” to Verb Patterns in Senior English
grammar.usage:
动名词作宾语，指动词的 -ing 形式在句中充当及物动词或介词的宾语，具有名词功能。核心结构为“主语 + 谓语动词 + doing sth.”，其中 doing 不是进行时，而是动名词。肯定句如：She enjoys swimming. 否定句在谓语动词上否定：He doesn’t mind waiting. 疑问句将助动词提前：Do you mind opening the window? 动名词作宾语通常表示习惯性、一般性、已完成的动作，或把动作当作一个整体概念来看待。

高中阶段需要把“动名词作宾语”从单个动词搭配，提升为“动词 + 宾语”的句型体系。初中只要求记住 enjoy, finish, practice, mind 等少数动词后接 doing，并能区分 want to do 与 enjoy doing。高中则要求进一步掌握：只能接动名词的动词（admit, avoid, consider, delay, deny, escape, fancy, imagine, keep, miss, postpone, risk, suggest 等）、只能接不定式的动词（decide, hope, expect, plan, refuse, promise 等），以及既可接 doing 又可接 to do 但意义不同的动词（remember, forget, stop, try, mean, regret）。

与近义结构对比：动名词作宾语与不定式作宾语的核心区别在于“时间感”和“抽象感”。动名词常表示已经发生、正在发生或泛指的行为，如 I remember locking the door（记得已经锁过门）；不定式常表示尚未发生或具体某次要做的事，如 Remember to lock the door（记得要去锁门）。love, like, hate, prefer 等表示喜好的动词，接 doing 与 to do 意义接近，但 doing 更强调习惯性、泛指，to do 更强调具体某次或将来倾向。

易错点一：介词后必须用动名词，不能用不定式，如 be good at doing, look forward to doing, be used to doing，其中 to 是介词不是不定式符号。易错点二：某些动词如 suggest, enjoy, finish, avoid, mind 后接 doing，但学生常受汉语影响误用 to do。易错点三：remember, forget, stop, try, mean, regret 后接 doing 与 to do 意义完全不同，高考常考语境辨析。易错点四：动名词的否定形式是 not doing，放在谓语动词之后，如 He admitted not telling the truth，而不是 didn’t tell。
forms: 主语 + 谓语动词 + doing sth.（She enjoys swimming.）
主语 + 谓语动词 + not doing sth.（He admitted not telling the truth.）
主语 + 系动词 + 形容词/过去分词 + 介词 + doing（I am interested in learning French.）
主语 + 谓语动词 + sb./sth. + doing（I can’t imagine him doing such a thing.）
主语 + 谓语动词 + doing / to do（意义不同：remember doing vs. remember to do）
主语 + 谓语动词 + doing / to do（意义相近：love doing ≈ love to do）
notes: 高考高频考点：remember, forget, stop, try, mean, regret 后接 doing 与 to do 意义不同，必须结合语境判断动作是否已发生。
书面语中，动名词作宾语比不定式更正式、更抽象，如 I suggest adopting a different approach 比 I suggest you to adopt 更符合正式语体。
介词后的 to 不是不定式符号，look forward to doing, be used to doing, object to doing 中的 to 后必须接动名词。
动名词的否定形式是 not doing，不是 don’t do，如 He denied having stolen the money 或 He denied stealing the money。
语域提醒：口语中 like doing 与 like to do 常混用，但正式写作中表示长期习惯偏好时优先用 doing。

grammar.key: Adverbial Clause of Reason (because) / 原因状语从句 (because)
grammar.title: 原因状语从句（because / since / as / for）及高中拓展
grammar.titleEn: Adverbial Clauses of Reason: because, since, as, for and Related Structures
grammar.usage:
原因状语从句用于说明主句动作或状态发生的原因，回答“为什么”的问题。最核心、最常见的引导词是 because，它表示直接、明确、语气最强的原因，常用于回答 why 提出的问题。because 引导的从句既可以放在主句之后，也可以放在主句之前；放在主句之前时，从句后通常要用逗号与主句隔开。例如：Because it was late, we decided to leave. 从句放在主句之后时，一般不加逗号。

肯定句结构为“主句 + because + 原因状语从句”或“Because + 原因状语从句 + 主句”。否定句通常在主句部分进行否定，例如：He didn't go to the party because he was ill. 需要注意的是，当 because 从句前出现否定词时，可能产生歧义，书面语中要结合语境判断否定范围。疑问句一般用 why 对原因进行提问，回答时用 because 引出原因，例如：—Why was she late? —Because she missed the bus.

在近义结构方面，because、since、as、for 都可以表示原因，但语气和用法有区别。because 语气最强，表示直接原因，常用于回答 why 或强调原因本身；since 和 as 语气较弱，通常表示已知的、显而易见的原因，多放在句首，侧重于“既然”的含义；for 是并列连词，连接的是并列句而非状语从句，表示补充说明或推测性的原因，不用于句首，前面常有逗号。例如：It must have rained last night, for the ground is wet.

初中阶段主要要求掌握 because 引导的原因状语从句，能正确回答 why 问句，并注意 because 与 so 不能同时使用。高中阶段则进一步要求区分 because、since、as、for 的语域和语气差异，掌握 because of、due to、owing to、thanks to、on account of 等介词短语表示原因的结构，并能在书面表达中根据正式程度和语境选择恰当的表达方式。此外，高中还涉及 not because...but because...、partly because...partly because... 等并列原因结构，以及 because 从句在强调句中的使用，如 It was because he was careless that he failed the exam.
forms: 主句 + because + 原因状语从句（陈述语序）
Because + 原因状语从句, + 主句
Why + 一般疑问句? → Because + 原因状语从句
主句 + because of + 名词/代词/动名词
Since/As + 原因状语从句, + 主句（语气较弱，表示已知原因）
主句, + for + 并列分句（补充说明原因，不用于句首）
notes: because 和 so 不能在同一句中同时使用，这是高考书面表达中的常见扣分点。
because 后接从句，because of 后接名词、代词或动名词，高考语法填空常考这一区别。
for 表示原因时是并列连词，不能放在句首，且语气较弱，多用于书面语或正式文体中。
since 和 as 引导原因状语从句时，通常放在句首，表示“既然”或已知原因，语气比 because 弱，适合在书面表达中体现语域差异。
在否定句中，because 从句可能造成歧义，例如 He didn't marry her because she was rich 可有两种理解，高考阅读和写作中需根据上下文判断否定范围。

grammar.key: Passive Voice (Present Simple) / 被动语态 (一般现在时)
grammar.title: 一般现在时被动语态：am/is/are done 及其拓展（含情态动词被动、与主动句转换）
grammar.titleEn: Present Simple Passive Voice: am/is/are + Past Participle
grammar.usage:
被动语态表示主语是动作的承受者，而不是执行者。一般现在时被动语态的核心结构为：am/is/are + 过去分词。当主语是单数第三人称时用 is，主语是 I 时用 am，其余情况用 are。被动语态常用于以下场景：动作的执行者不重要、不明确或无需提及时；更强调动作的承受者或动作本身时；在科普、新闻、说明书、规章制度等正式语体中尤为常见。

肯定句结构为“主语 + am/is/are + 过去分词”，否定句在 be 动词后加 not，疑问句将 be 动词提到主语之前。例如：The room is cleaned every day. / The room is not cleaned every day. / Is the room cleaned every day?

与主动语态相比，被动语态把原来的宾语提升为主语，原来的主语则常以“by + 执行者”的形式出现，但多数情况下可以省略。例如主动句 People speak English in many countries. 可转换为被动句 English is spoken in many countries (by people). 需要注意的是，只有及物动词或及物动词短语才有被动语态，不及物动词如 happen、appear、die、arrive 等不能用于被动结构。

初中阶段主要要求掌握一般现在时、一般过去时和含情态动词的被动语态基本结构，能够进行主动与被动之间的简单转换。高中阶段则进一步要求：在书面表达中恰当使用被动语态以增强客观性和正式感；掌握“情态动词 + be + 过去分词”结构（如 can be done, must be done, should be done）；理解被动语态与系表结构的区别；在阅读中识别复杂句中的被动结构并准确判断时态和语态。

易错点一：混淆被动语态与系表结构。被动语态强调动作，系表结构强调状态。例如 The door is closed. 如果表示“门被关上了”这一动作，是被动语态；如果表示“门是关着的”这一状态，则是系表结构，需根据上下文判断。易错点二：漏掉 be 动词或过去分词形式错误。被动语态必须同时具备 be 动词和过去分词，缺一不可，且不规则动词的过去分词要记牢。易错点三：不及物动词误用被动。如 The accident was happened yesterday. 是错误的，应为 The accident happened yesterday. 易错点四：主动形式表被动含义的动词。如 sell、wash、read、write 等词在表示主语本身具有某种属性时，常用主动形式表被动含义，例如 This book sells well.（这本书很畅销。）
forms: 肯定式：主语 + am/is/are + 过去分词 (+ by + 执行者)
否定式：主语 + am/is/are + not + 过去分词
一般疑问式：Am/Is/Are + 主语 + 过去分词?
特殊疑问式：疑问词 + am/is/are + 主语 + 过去分词?
情态动词被动式：主语 + 情态动词 + be + 过去分词
主动转被动：主动句宾语 → 被动句主语；主动句谓语 → be + 过去分词；主动句主语 → by + 宾语（可省略）
notes: 高考书面表达中，适当使用被动语态可以增强文章的客观性和正式感，尤其在议论文、说明文和新闻报道类写作中。
注意“情态动词 + be + 过去分词”结构中 be 动词永远用原形，不受主语人称和数的影响。
不及物动词和部分不及物动词短语（如 take place, break out, belong to）没有被动语态，高考语法填空和改错中常考。
有些动词的主动形式可表示被动含义，如 sell, wash, read, write, wear 等，常与 well, easily 等副词连用，注意不要误改为被动。
在语域较高的正式文体中，by + 执行者常被省略，除非执行者是重要信息或需要特别强调。
